title:
Comment of Ikuko Hibbs in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/28/2026

documents.name: 151870.txt
documents.text:
Ikuko Hibbs, Crown Point, IN.
I strongly oppose DeepGreen's proposed underwater AI data center project (Docket No. P-15423-000) in Cook Inlet. With only 331 endangered beluga whales remaining, FERC cannot justify adding a massive industrial project directly within their critical habitat. Belugas depend on sound to survive, and additional underwater noise, habitat disruption, and cumulative impacts could further jeopardize their recovery. This project should be denied unless it can be proven beyond doubt that it will not harm Cook Inlet belugas.
